phases.name: idle

motion.replayGuarantee: Same species version/runtime, fixed initial options and seed, explicit tick/event log gives identical state, samples and cells. Config/reset/host suspension starts a new log; no cross-engine/font pixel guarantee.

interaction.pointer: CSS-rect [-1,1], DPR independent. Pointer and taps guide only; explicit Dart button triggers the single specimen.
interaction.keyboard: Native Dart/Pause/Reset and Guide/Motion/View selectors; focused canvas arrows guide, Space pauses.
interaction.touch: Tap guides; large native controls trigger action. Page scrolling retained.
interaction.precedence: Pause/static/visibility policy overrides motion. Events follow strictly increasing seq; first eligible dart wins; cooldown ignores repeats.

accessibility.description: A dragonfly drawn in characters, with large eyes, a long segmented abdomen and four narrow wings.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Static poster on live OS preference; deliberate alternate pose. Slow mode is available; pointer never opts into animation.
accessibility.pause: Independent user pause composes with static/hidden/offscreen/zero size/disposed. Reset/config preserve pause.
accessibility.liveRegion: Sparse user action status only; never per-frame narration.
